description: An accessible bodyweight horizontal pull using a sturdy doorframe or vertical pillar to train back and bicep mechanics.
setup: Stand close facing a sturdy doorframe, gripping the edge of the frame with one or both hands at chest level, placing toes near the base.
steps: Lean upper body backward until arms are fully extended and weight is supported on heels.
Engage lats and retract shoulder blades toward your spine.
Pull your chest firmly toward the frame until hands contact ribs or chest.
Lower back down with smooth control until arms reach full extension.
cues: Lead the pull with elbows driving behind you
Keep torso as straight and rigid as a plank

mistakes.mistake: Piking hips back instead of maintaining straight body line
mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes and abs so entire body moves as one unified lever

mistakes.mistake: Yanking with arms before engaging shoulder blades
mistakes.fix: Initiate each repetition by pinching shoulder blades together first

rep_standard: Chest approaches doorframe at peak contraction, arms reach full extension at bottom
